The *Paṭisandahanapañha* ("The Question on Awareness of the Ending of Rebirth") is a section of the *Milindapañha*. Modern translations of the text include an English translation by John Kelly, as part of four translations available across three languages.

A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese translation of the *Milindapañha* literature at T 1670b 2.17 under the title "Knowledge of Having Rebirth".
